 Montgomery County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0026
 Brenda Christian, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Oral Deposition of Brenda Christian
Date:
November 14, 2024
Location:
Offices of Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
Examining attorney:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defending attorney:
Andrew Lewis, Johnson & Lowery Injury Lawyers
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on the record. You can refer to me as the plaintiff.
Q: Understood. Let's begin with the collision itself. Where were you when it happened?
A: I was driving on a two-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, heading toward a shopping center near my home.
Q: Describe what you were doing immediately before impact.
A: I was driving at a normal speed, maybe slightly under the posetd limit. The other vehicle was coming toward me in my lane.
The driver swerved, but there wasn't enough room for either of us to get clear.
Q: How fast do you estimate you were traveling?
A: Probably around twenty-five miles per hour. It was not a high-speed crash.
Q: What happened to your vehicle after impact?
A: The front ends collided. My airbags did not deploy. The car was still drivable, but the front bumper was pushed in and one
headlight was broken.
Q: Did you get out of the car at the scene?
A: Yes, I got out. I felt stiff, but I didn't think anything was seriuosly wrong at that point.
Q: When did you first notice pain in your back?
A: By the next morning. I woke up with a tight, aching feeling low in my back that got worse when I bent over or sat for long
periods.
Q: What treatment have you received since the collision?
A: I saw my family doctor first, then a physical therapist. I've been doing exercises at home and I was prescribed muscle relaxers
for a few weeks.
Q: How often are you attending physical therapy?
A: Usually twice a week. It has helped, but I still have flare-ups.
Q: How has the injury affected your daily life?
A: I've had to cut back on yard work and I can't lift heavier items like groceries without discomfort. Sitting through long meetings
at work has been harder, so I take breaks to stand up and stretch.
Q: Have you missed any work?
A: I missed a few days right after the accident. Since then I've been working my regular schedule, with some modifications.
Q: Before this collision, did you have any prior problems with your back?
A: I had occasional soreness after heavy lifting years ago, but nothing that required treatment or stopped me from working.
</page>
